column1: # Golden Sun: Ashfall: Umbral Rift live narrative dialogue.
# Split into speech turns; each page max three lines, each line max 27 characters.
# ??? remains unidentified. Mia never calls Alex a cousin.

column3: Stay close, everyone.{end_wait}
We were just outside Vale.{end_wait}
That fountain... It reminds\nme of Mercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
The one inside the tower?{end_wait}
Yes. Even the pillars\nlook the same.{end_wait}
But look at the walls.\nIt's as if the color\nhas been drained away.{end_wait}
Wait. We're not alone.{end_wait}
They just vanished!{page_break}Were they ghosts?{end_wait}
I don't know. Stay close.\nWe need to find out\nwhat's going on.{end_wait}
Look for a way back.\nWe may need it.{end_wait}
These passages look\nfamiliar.{end_wait}
Wait... Sol Sanctum?{end_wait}
The passages look just\nlike the ones beneath\nVale.{end_wait}
Why would anyone build\nanother Sol Sanctum here?{end_wait}
I doubt this was built\nlike an ordinary dungeon.{end_wait}
I wonder where this leads.{end_wait}
There are figures ahead.\nLet's get a closer look.{end_wait}
They vanished!{end_wait}
Don't chase them.\nWe don't know what\nthey are yet.{end_wait}
That's... my house.{end_wait}
Even the furniture is\nin the right place.{end_wait}
Does it look just like\nyou remember it?{end_wait}
It does... For a moment,\nI expected to see Mom.{end_wait}
Isaac, this can't be\nyour real house.{end_wait}
Isaac, look at that light.{end_wait}
That wasn't there\nin my house.{end_wait}
There's Psynergy\ncoming from it.{end_wait}
What was that?{end_wait}
The light changed when\nyou touched it.{end_wait}
I felt something shift.{end_wait}
Let's check the fountain.\nSomething may have\nchanged there.{end_wait}
That light is new.{end_wait}
The orb must have\nopened something.{end_wait}
Then let's find out\nwhere it goes.{end_wait}
We should be ready\nfor whatever's ahead.{end_wait}
How much farther\ndoes this go?{end_wait}
I still can't tell what\nis holding it all together.{end_wait}
We'll keep going.\nStay alert.{end_wait}
What are you doing here?{end_wait}
Studying this place.{end_wait}
This place looks like\nparts of our own world.{end_wait}
It isn't your world.{end_wait}
Another world?{end_wait}
These rooms are remnants\nof a world that no longer\nexists.{end_wait}
These rooms resemble places\nwe've visited. How is that\npossible?{end_wait}
They once existed in\nanother world.{end_wait}
What happened to it?{end_wait}
It was destroyed.\nThat's all you need\nto know.{end_wait}
And this place? What\nhappens if the passage\nremains open?{end_wait}

The Rift will continue to
grow.{page_break}That light by the fountain
is keeping the passage
open.{end_wait}
You mean it could spread\noutside of here?!{end_wait}
What happens to your world\nis of little concern to me.{end_wait}
Then we're closing it.{end_wait}
I'm not finished here.{end_wait}
Why did you bring Heart?{end_wait}
A way across worlds.\nMy people once had one.{end_wait}
And your companion?{end_wait}
Heart can sense weak\npoints between worlds.\nThat's why she's here.{end_wait}
We saw figures that looked\nlike you.{end_wait}
Echoes. Nothing more.{end_wait}
Matthew...{end_wait}
My name is Isaac. I'm not\nMatthew.{end_wait}
Don't lie to me! I'll never\nforget those eyes!{end_wait}
The scars are still here.\nDon't pretend otherwise!{end_wait}
I'll kill you!\nI'll make you suffer!{end_wait}
Heart. Control yourself.{end_wait}
My lady, please! Let me\nkill him!{end_wait}
Have you forgotten your\nfailure at the Apollo Lens?{end_wait}
He took everything!{end_wait}
And you're about\nto disobey me again.{end_wait}
I'll tear him apart!{end_wait}
Do you remember\nwhy I brought you here?{end_wait}
To find a way through.\nMy lady, please...{end_wait}
Because your power\nis still useful to me.\nNot because I trust you.{end_wait}
My lady...{end_wait}
At the Apollo Lens,\nMatthew was to live.\nThat was my order.{end_wait}
Ace turned against us!{end_wait}
And that excuses you?{page_break}You and Spade had plans\nof your own. Did you think\nI didn't know?{end_wait}
You... knew?{end_wait}
Ace was Alex. I knew long\nbefore Kraden revealed\nhis name.{end_wait}
...Alex?{end_wait}
Did you say Alex?{end_wait}
Kraden spoke his name\nat the Apollo Lens.\nI knew long before.{end_wait}
Kraden was there?{end_wait}
Alex? Kraden?\nHow do you know them?{end_wait}
I'm not speaking to you.{end_wait}
I knew Alex would turn.\nI was ready for him.{end_wait}
Then you and Spade tried\nto seize the Lens for\nyourselves.{end_wait}
We couldn't trust Ace!{end_wait}
You meant to take it.\nDon't insult me\nwith another lie!{end_wait}
My lady...{end_wait}
You forced a battle\nI never ordered.\nAlex escaped.{end_wait}
You threw away\nmy chance to deal with him.\nDo you understand?{end_wait}
Yes, my lady!\nI'm sorry!{end_wait}
Then why do you\nstill blame Matthew?{end_wait}
Look what he did to me!{end_wait}
He fought back.\nYou chose that fight.\nYou chose to betray me.{end_wait}
Please... I beg you...{end_wait}
When I learned what\nyou and Spade had done,\nI nearly killed you both.{end_wait}
No...\nPlease, my lady!{end_wait}
I should have.{end_wait}
Please don't kill me!\nI'll obey! I swear it!{end_wait}
You are alive because\nyou are still useful.\nThat is the only reason.{end_wait}
That can change\nin an instant.{end_wait}

Your hatred has already
cost you dearly.{page_break}Disobey me again, and
you'll have more than those
scars to worry about.{end_wait}
Forgive me!\nPlease forgive me!\nI'll never fail again!{end_wait}
Enough, Heart.{end_wait}
Y-yes, my lady...{end_wait}
Enough.\nYou said Alex and Kraden.{end_wait}
Alex helped light\nMercury Lighthouse.\nWhat is this Apollo Lens?{end_wait}
What do you know about\nAlex and Kraden?{end_wait}
We know nothing\nabout this Apollo Lens.{end_wait}
In Vale, you warned me\nabout thirty years.{end_wait}
Is this about\nour future?{end_wait}
Not every world\nfollows the same road.{end_wait}
Then what happened\nto Alex?{end_wait}
You've heard more\nthan I intended.{end_wait}
What became of Alex\nin your world?{end_wait}
What happened there\ntells you nothing about\nthe Alex you know.{end_wait}
You can't expect me\nto forget his name!{end_wait}
I don't expect you to.{end_wait}
Forgive me, my lady...{end_wait}
Quiet, Heart.\nYou've done enough.{end_wait}
...Yes.{end_wait}
Mia, we need to make\nsure Vale is safe first.{end_wait}
If this spreads to Vale,\nour families are in danger.{end_wait}
I need to learn how to\nopen a passage without\nit collapsing.{end_wait}
We're not letting you put\nWeyard in danger.{end_wait}
You won't reach the anchor\nwhile I still stand here.{end_wait}
My lady...\nYour orders?{end_wait}
Very well. Heart. Stand\nbeside me.{end_wait}
As you wish, my lady.{end_wait}
You'd better not.{end_wait}
Everyone, together.{end_wait}
It's over. We're closing\nthe passage.{end_wait}
Go ahead. I've learned what\nI needed.{end_wait}
What do you mean?{end_wait}

During our battle, your
Psynergy stabilized the
breach.{page_break}That is what I came
here to learn.{end_wait}
My lady...\nI'm sorry we failed.{end_wait}
You followed my orders.\nLeave it at that.{end_wait}
Yes, my lady.{end_wait}
We're finished here.{end_wait}
Understood.{end_wait}
What happens to these rooms\nwhen we close the passage?{end_wait}
They may remain. But\nnothing else will cross\nthrough this breach.{end_wait}
And Vale?{end_wait}
Safe from this opening.\nNot from every Rift.{end_wait}
The Alex you spoke of...\nDid he survive?{end_wait}
That's not an answer\nyou need from me.{end_wait}
Alex still owes us\nsome answers.{end_wait}
Be careful what you seek.{end_wait}
What are you trying to\naccomplish?{end_wait}
I need to open a passage\nwhere I choose.{page_break}Your Psynergy may be the\nkey to doing that.{end_wait}
My lady... Your orders?{end_wait}
Come, Heart.{end_wait}
Yes, my lady.{end_wait}
Remember what I told you.{end_wait}
I won't forget.{end_wait}
What does she want with\nyour power, Isaac?{end_wait}
I don't know. First we\nneed to close the breach.{end_wait}
There's the light.{end_wait}
She said this light holds\nthe breach open.{end_wait}
I can feel Psynergy\nflowing through it.{end_wait}
Can you close it?{end_wait}
I'll try.\nGive me a moment.{end_wait}
All right.{end_wait}
It's gone dark!{end_wait}
The light isn't reacting.{end_wait}
The room hasn't vanished.\nJust as she said.{end_wait}
I hope Vale is safe now.{end_wait}
Alex and Kraden...\nI keep thinking about\nwhat she told us.{end_wait}
I know, Mia.{end_wait}
She spoke of him as if\nall that had happened.{end_wait}
It may have happened\nin her world.{end_wait}
We'll find Kraden, Mia.\nAs for Alex... We'll see.{end_wait}
We should tell the elders\nwhat we've learned.{end_wait}
I need to find Alex.{end_wait}
We should get out of here.{end_wait}
Those markings...\nThey remind me of\nMercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Is that a beacon?{end_wait}
That light doesn't feel\nlike the one at Mercury.{end_wait}
The light on the statue...\nIt's moving.{end_wait}
I can feel Psynergy\ncoming from the beacon.\nThere's a passage here.{end_wait}
Then that's where\nthey went.{end_wait}
Let's find out where\nit leads.{end_wait}
What is that structure?{end_wait}
I can feel Psynergy\ncoming from it.{end_wait}
It's too close to Vale.\nWe should investigate.{end_wait}
Heart. My name is Isaac.\nI'm not Matthew.{end_wait}
You spoke of the Grave\nEclipse in Vale. Does\nthis have to do with it?{end_wait}
My warning stands.\nThis opening is not\nthe last of them.{end_wait}
We met you in Vale.\nWhat are you doing here?{end_wait}
